false_positives.reason: The common declaration const auto text = Wide(wxMBConvUTF8(), utf8) supplies storage used after the empty check in the __WXMSW__ branch. That branch reads text->size() and passes text->data() to both WideCharToMultiByte calls. Moving text into the if initializer would end its scope before these supported Windows uses. The Linux analysis omits the conditional consumers. Preserve the declaration and native conversion buffer lifetime.
